'''Ivan Talos'''<ref name="Rulebook">{{SWIA|set=Return to Hoth|rulebook=1}}</ref> was a [[Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Verena Talos/Legends|Verena Talos']] twin brother. Throughout their youth, Ivan and Verena were always competing with each other. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], a difference in ideology sent them to opposite sides of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|conflict]]. Ivan joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] while his sister joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="Know Your Enemy" />
